services.name: Frontend Development
services.shortDescription: Fast, responsive web interfaces with modern frameworks and clean component architecture.
services.description: We build fast, responsive and accessible web interfaces with React, Next.js and TypeScript — engineered for performance, SEO and long-term maintainability.

faqs.q: How long does frontend development take?
faqs.a: A marketing site typically takes 2–4 weeks; a full application frontend with dashboards and integrations usually takes 6–12 weeks depending on scope. We confirm a timeline after a short discovery call.

faqs.q: Do you build responsive websites?
faqs.a: Yes — every interface is designed mobile-first and verified across phone, tablet and desktop breakpoints before delivery.

faqs.q: Can you integrate with our existing APIs?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We build typed API clients against your REST or GraphQL endpoints and handle loading, error and empty states throughout.

faqs.q: Do you work with existing applications?
faqs.a: Yes. We can extend, refactor or gradually migrate an existing frontend — including strangler-pattern migrations off legacy stacks.

faqs.q: Can you improve an existing slow frontend?
faqs.a: Yes. We start with a performance audit (bundle, images, render bottlenecks) and then fix the highest-impact issues first.

faqs.q: Do you provide ongoing maintenance?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer maintenance plans covering updates, monitoring, small feature work and performance reviews.

services.name: Backend Development
services.shortDescription: Robust Node.js APIs, authentication and database architecture that scale with you.
services.description: We design secure REST APIs, authentication systems and database schemas with Node.js and Express — the reliable foundation your product runs on.

faqs.q: Which backend stack do you use?
faqs.a: Primarily Node.js with Express and MongoDB or PostgreSQL, chosen per project. We can also work with your existing stack.

faqs.q: How do you handle authentication?
faqs.a: Secure password hashing with bcrypt, JWT-based sessions, and role-based access control enforced on every protected endpoint.

faqs.q: Can you integrate payment gateways?
faqs.a: Yes — Stripe and similar providers, including subscriptions, webhooks and reconciliation flows.

faqs.q: Do you document the APIs?
faqs.a: Yes. Every endpoint ships with request/response documentation your frontend or partner teams can build against.

faqs.q: Can you scale an existing backend?
faqs.a: Yes. We profile bottlenecks (queries, indexes, N+1 calls) and fix them before adding caching or horizontal scaling.

faqs.q: Do you support deployment?
faqs.a: Yes — environment setup, deployment pipelines and monitoring guidance are part of delivery.

services.name: Mobile Development
services.shortDescription: Polished iOS and Android apps from a single codebase, wired to your backend.
services.description: We build cross-platform mobile apps with one codebase for iOS and Android — native feel, push notifications, offline support and store-ready releases.

faqs.q: Native or cross-platform — which should I choose?
faqs.a: For most business apps, cross-platform (React Native) delivers ~95% of the experience at roughly half the cost. We recommend true native only for heavy 3D, video editing or Bluetooth-intensive use cases.

faqs.q: How long does app development take?
faqs.a: A focused MVP typically takes 8–12 weeks including backend integration and store submission. Larger apps with offline sync or custom hardware features take longer.

faqs.q: Do you handle App Store and Play Store submission?
faqs.a: Yes — certificates, listings, screenshots, privacy declarations and review responses are all included.

faqs.q: Can the app work offline?
faqs.a: Yes for defined workflows. We design offline-first data sync so field teams keep working without signal and sync later.

faqs.q: Can you add push notifications to my existing app?
faqs.a: Yes — we can integrate push into an existing codebase along with segmentation and analytics.

faqs.q: Do you provide post-launch support?
faqs.a: Yes — OS updates, store policy changes and crash fixes are covered under maintenance plans.

services.name: Cloud & DevOps
services.shortDescription: Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines and monitoring for reliable releases.
services.description: We set up cloud hosting, automated deployments, Docker environments and monitoring — so releases become routine instead of risky events.

faqs.q: Which cloud provider should I use?
faqs.a: It depends on scale and budget. We commonly deploy on AWS, Render, Vercel or Netlify, and will recommend based on your traffic, team and cost constraints.

faqs.q: Can you fix our existing deployment process?
faqs.a: Yes. We audit the current setup, then introduce automation incrementally — usually CI first, then staging parity, then automated production deploys.

faqs.q: Do you use Docker?
faqs.a: Yes. Containerizing services eliminates environment drift between development, staging and production.

faqs.q: How do you handle monitoring?
faqs.a: Health-check endpoints, uptime monitors, error tracking and log aggregation with alerts routed to your team’s channel of choice.

faqs.q: Can you reduce our cloud bill?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Right-sizing instances, cleaning orphaned resources and choosing managed services wisely typically cuts waste significantly.

faqs.q: Do you document everything?
faqs.a: Always. You get a runbook covering deploys, rollbacks, secrets rotation and common incidents — no black boxes.

services.name: UI/UX Design
services.shortDescription: Research-backed UX, wireframes, prototypes and design systems that convert.
services.description: We turn fuzzy ideas into tested interfaces — user research, wireframes, interactive prototypes and complete design systems developers love to build from.

faqs.q: What does your design process look like?
faqs.a: Research → flows → wireframes → prototype → test → visual system. You review and approve at each stage, so there are no big-bang surprises.

faqs.q: Can you redesign our existing product?
faqs.a: Yes. We start with a UX audit of your current product, prioritize the highest-friction flows, and redesign incrementally so development never stalls.

faqs.q: Do you test with real users?
faqs.a: Yes — moderated or unmoderated tests with 5–8 representative users per round, which reliably surfaces the biggest issues.

faqs.q: What do developers receive?
faqs.a: A Figma system with components, states, spacing tokens, responsive rules and exportable assets — everything needed to build pixel-accurate screens.

faqs.q: Can you just do a logo or landing page?
faqs.a: Yes for focused engagements, though most clients get the most value from a full flow or system engagement.

faqs.q: Do you handle branding too?
faqs.a: We handle product-side identity (logo usage, colors, typography). Full brand strategy is scoped separately on request.

services.name: Security & Testing
services.shortDescription: Security reviews, OWASP hardening and test coverage across your stack.
services.description: We harden applications against common attacks and back them with automated tests — so releases are safe, repeatable and drama-free.

faqs.q: What does a security review cover?
faqs.a: Authentication, authorization boundaries, input validation, file uploads, API abuse vectors, security headers, dependency risks and exposed secrets — mapped to OWASP categories with severity ratings.

faqs.q: Is this a certified penetration test?
faqs.a: No — this is an engineering-led security review and hardening engagement. If you need a certified pentest for compliance, we prepare your app for it and can recommend partners.

faqs.q: Do you fix the issues you find?
faqs.a: Yes. Findings come with fixes for the agreed scope, followed by re-testing to confirm each issue is closed.

faqs.q: What testing frameworks do you use?
faqs.a: We match your stack — typically Jest/Vitest for unit, Supertest for APIs, and Playwright or Cypress for end-to-end flows.

faqs.q: Can you add tests to our existing project?
faqs.a: Yes. We start with the highest-risk paths (auth, payments, core workflows) and expand coverage iteratively.

faqs.q: Will testing slow down our releases?
faqs.a: The opposite — automated suites run in minutes on every push and catch regressions that manual QA would miss or find too late.

services.name: AI Development
services.shortDescription: LLM-powered features, assistants and intelligent search built on your data.
services.description: We integrate large language models into real products — support assistants, semantic search, summarization and AI agents with guardrails, evals and cost controls.

faqs.q: What kinds of AI features can you build?
faqs.a: Support assistants, semantic search, document Q&A, summarization, ticket triage, lead enrichment and multi-step AI agents — always grounded in your data.

faqs.q: How do you prevent hallucinations?
faqs.a: Retrieval grounding, citation requirements, structured outputs, confidence thresholds and human review queues for high-stakes answers.

faqs.q: How much do LLM API calls cost?
faqs.a: It varies by volume, but we design with caching, smaller models for simple tasks and token budgets — you see projected costs before we build.

faqs.q: Can AI work on our private data?
faqs.a: Yes. Your documents are embedded into a private vector store; the model only sees retrieved snippets relevant to each question.

faqs.q: Do you train custom models?
faqs.a: Rarely needed. Retrieval + good prompting beats fine-tuning for most business use cases at a fraction of the cost. We advise honestly on this.

faqs.q: How do you test AI features?
faqs.a: With evaluation sets: curated question/answer pairs run against every prompt or model change, so regressions are caught automatically.

services.name: AI Automations
services.shortDescription: Workflow automation across your tools — leads, tickets, notifications and data entry.
services.description: We connect your apps and automate repetitive workflows — lead routing, ticket triage, follow-ups, reports and syncs — with AI handling the judgment calls.

faqs.q: What tools do you use for automation?
faqs.a: n8n, Make and direct API/webhook integrations — chosen per task. We prefer tools your team can inspect and extend, not black boxes.

faqs.q: What can actually be automated?
faqs.a: Lead capture and routing, follow-up sequences, ticket triage, data sync between tools, report generation, notifications, onboarding checklists — if it is rules plus judgment, it is a candidate.

faqs.q: What happens when an automation fails?
faqs.a: Every flow has error handling: retries for transient failures, alerts to your team for real ones, and safe fallbacks so nothing silently breaks.

faqs.q: Can AI make decisions in the workflow?
faqs.a: Yes, within guardrails — e.g. classifying intent or drafting replies that a human approves. High-stakes actions always require human confirmation.

faqs.q: Will we be locked into a platform?
faqs.a: No. We document every flow and prefer portable patterns (webhooks, standard APIs) so you can migrate or self-host later.

faqs.q: How do you price automation work?
faqs.a: Fixed scope per workflow bundle after a mapping session — no hourly meters running while we think.

services.name: AI Solutions
services.shortDescription: End-to-end AI programs — strategy, copilots, agents and business intelligence.
services.description: Beyond single features: AI roadmaps, intelligent assistants, business-intelligence layers and agent systems designed around your operations and data maturity.

faqs.q: We don’t know where to start with AI. Can you help?
faqs.a: That is exactly what the opportunity assessment is for — a structured look at your workflows and data, ending in a ranked roadmap, not a sales pitch.

faqs.q: How is this different from AI Development?
faqs.a: AI Development ships a specific feature. AI Solutions is the program around it: strategy, multiple use cases, data foundations and adoption across teams.

faqs.q: Will our data be used to train public models?
faqs.a: No. We use API-based models with no-training data policies and private retrieval stores. Your data never trains anyone else’s model.

faqs.q: How do you measure success?
faqs.a: Each slice gets success metrics up front — hours saved, response times, accuracy on eval sets — reviewed quarterly.

faqs.q: Can you work with our in-house team?
faqs.a: Yes. We commonly pair with internal developers and hand over documented systems with training.

faqs.q: What does it cost?
faqs.a: Assessment is a fixed-scope engagement; build slices are scoped per use case against the roadmap. No open-ended retainers required to start.

services.name: Chatbot Development
services.shortDescription: AI website chatbots for support, leads and FAQs — with human handoff.
services.description: We build website chatbots that answer from your knowledge base, capture leads, and hand off to humans gracefully — cutting support load while lifting conversions.

faqs.q: Will the chatbot make up answers?
faqs.a: No — it answers only from your knowledge base with retrieval grounding, and says so (then offers human contact) when it doesn’t know.

faqs.q: Can it capture leads?
faqs.a: Yes. It collects contact details conversationally, scores intent from the dialogue, and pushes warm leads to your CRM or inbox instantly.

faqs.q: What happens when it can’t help?
faqs.a: It hands off to your team with the full transcript, or takes a callback request — the visitor is never left hanging.

faqs.q: Can we update answers ourselves?
faqs.a: Yes. You edit the knowledge base (docs/FAQs) and the bot picks up changes without code deploys.

faqs.q: Does it work on mobile?
faqs.a: Yes — the widget is fully responsive and tested across phone and tablet viewports.

faqs.q: Can it integrate with our CRM?
faqs.a: Yes — leads, transcripts and tags sync to your CRM or helpdesk, including custom CRMs we build.

services.name: RAG System Integration
services.shortDescription: Retrieval-augmented generation over private docs with cited, current answers.
services.description: We connect your documents to LLMs with embeddings and vector search — so teams and customers get accurate, cited answers from private company knowledge.

faqs.q: What is RAG in simple terms?
faqs.a: Instead of the AI answering from memory, it first looks up your documents (like a librarian) and then answers using what it found — with citations. Accurate and private.

faqs.q: What documents can it handle?
faqs.a: PDFs, Word docs, wikis, help centers, tickets, sheets and most text sources. Scanned PDFs need OCR, which we include where required.

faqs.q: How do answers stay current?
faqs.a: Documents are versioned and re-indexed on a schedule or on change. Stale chunks are replaced, never mixed in.

faqs.q: Is our data used to train AI models?
faqs.a: No. Embeddings and retrieval stay in your private store; generation APIs are used with no-training data handling.

faqs.q: How do you measure answer quality?
faqs.a: With a curated eval set of real questions and expected sources — precision/recall on retrieval plus answer faithfulness checks.

faqs.q: Can different teams see different documents?
faqs.a: Yes. Access controls filter retrieval by role or team, so sensitive sets stay restricted.

services.name: Business Solutions
services.shortDescription: Custom internal tools, dashboards and workflow digitization for operations.
services.description: We digitize messy operations into clean internal tools — dashboards, approval flows, inventory trackers and integrations that replace spreadsheets and chat chaos.

faqs.q: What counts as a business solution?
faqs.a: Any custom internal software: dashboards, approval systems, inventory trackers, scheduling tools, reporting portals — anything that replaces manual operational work.

faqs.q: Why not just use off-the-shelf software?
faqs.a: When your process is standard, buy. When you constantly fight the tool with workarounds and per-seat costs, custom wins — we’ll tell you honestly which case you’re in.

faqs.q: Can you migrate our spreadsheet data?
faqs.a: Yes. We clean, validate and import existing sheets, then verify totals match before go-live.

faqs.q: Who can access what?
faqs.a: Role-based permissions throughout — e.g. staff see their tasks, managers see team views, admins see everything, with audit logs.

faqs.q: Can it integrate with our existing tools?
faqs.a: Yes — accounting, WhatsApp/SMS, email, payment and common SaaS APIs via their official integrations.

faqs.q: Do you train our staff?
faqs.a: Yes. Role-specific walkthroughs plus concise documentation, so adoption doesn’t depend on us.

services.name: Custom CRM Development
services.shortDescription: Lead pipelines, automation and reporting designed for how you actually sell.
services.description: We build CRMs around your pipeline — lead capture, deal stages, sales automation, role permissions and reports that show the truth about your funnel.

faqs.q: Can you build a CRM from scratch?
faqs.a: Yes — that is the core offer. Pipeline, contacts, activities, automation, reports and permissions designed around your sales motion.

faqs.q: Can it integrate with our existing tools?
faqs.a: Yes — ad lead forms, WhatsApp, email, calendars, billing and your website/chatbot all feed into one pipeline.

faqs.q: Can different roles have different permissions?
faqs.a: Yes. Reps see their pipeline, managers see team performance, admins configure everything — with full audit trails.

faqs.q: Can workflows be automated?
faqs.a: Yes — lead assignment, follow-up sequences, stage triggers, escalation rules and notification flows.

faqs.q: Can AI features be integrated?
faqs.a: Yes. Lead scoring, conversation summaries and draft follow-ups can be added on top of the same data.

faqs.q: How long does a custom CRM take?
faqs.a: A focused CRM (pipeline + automation + reports) typically takes 8–14 weeks. Larger multi-team rollouts are phased.

services.name: ERP Development
services.shortDescription: Modular ERP covering finance, HR, inventory, sales and reporting.
services.description: We build modular ERP systems — finance, HR, inventory, procurement and sales in one permissioned platform with the reports leadership actually reads.

faqs.q: What modules can you build?
faqs.a: Finance, HR and attendance, inventory, sales, procurement, and reporting — delivered as phases so you see value early.

faqs.q: Can you migrate our existing data?
faqs.a: Yes — masters, opening balances, stock and employee records are cleaned, validated and imported with reconciliation checks.

faqs.q: How do permissions work?
faqs.a: Granular role permissions per module and per action (view/create/approve), with full audit logs of who did what.

faqs.q: Will operations stop during rollout?
faqs.a: No. We roll out module by module with parallel runs, so the business keeps operating throughout.

faqs.q: Can it handle multiple branches?
faqs.a: Yes — branch-scoped data with consolidated head-office reporting is a standard pattern for us.

faqs.q: How long does ERP development take?
faqs.a: A first module typically takes 10–16 weeks; full multi-module rollouts are phased over quarters.

services.name: SaaS Product Development
services.shortDescription: Multi-user SaaS with auth, billing, admin dashboards and analytics.
services.description: We take SaaS ideas from architecture to paying customers — multi-tenancy, subscriptions, admin tooling, analytics and the cloud setup to scale them.

faqs.q: How long does it take to launch a SaaS MVP?
faqs.a: A focused single-tenant MVP typically takes 12–16 weeks including billing and onboarding. True multi-tenant scale adds phases.

faqs.q: How do subscriptions work?
faqs.a: Stripe-powered plans with trials, coupons, upgrades/downgrades, proration and dunning for failed payments — all handled.

faqs.q: What is multi-tenancy?
faqs.a: Serving many customers from one deployment while strictly isolating their data. We enforce isolation at the database layer with automated tests proving it.

faqs.q: Can you migrate our existing app to SaaS?
faqs.a: Yes — we assess tenancy gaps, billing needs and onboarding, then migrate in phases without disrupting current users.

faqs.q: Do you help with pricing and packaging?
faqs.a: We advise from experience (tiers, usage meters, trial design) while you make the final business call.

faqs.q: What happens after launch?
faqs.a: Analytics reviews, onboarding optimization, feature flags for safe releases and a maintenance plan for scale.

services.name: Digital Marketing
services.shortDescription: SEO, AEO/GEO, content strategy and conversion optimization that grow organic traffic.
services.description: We grow your search visibility with technical SEO, content strategy and conversion optimization — including AEO and GEO so AI search engines cite your business too.

faqs.q: What digital marketing services do you provide?
faqs.a: Technical SEO audits and fixes, keyword and content strategy, on-page optimization, local SEO, AEO/GEO for AI search, and conversion optimization — all reported monthly in plain language.

faqs.q: Do you provide SEO?
faqs.a: Yes — technical, on-page, local and content-driven SEO. We fix foundations first, then build visibility that compounds.

faqs.q: What are AEO and GEO?
faqs.a: Answer Engine Optimization and Generative Engine Optimization: making your content the cited source when AI assistants and generative search answer customer questions.

faqs.q: How long until we see results?
faqs.a: Technical fixes often move metrics in 4–8 weeks; competitive keywords typically take 3–6 months of consistent work. We set expectations per keyword, not promises.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee first-page rankings?
faqs.a: No — and you should distrust anyone who does. Rankings depend on search engines and competition; we maximize your eligibility and report honestly.

faqs.q: Do you provide social media promotion?
faqs.a: Yes — see our Social Media Promotion service for content, campaigns and community growth across major platforms.

services.name: Social Media Promotion
services.shortDescription: Content, campaigns and community growth across Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.
services.description: We run your social presence end to end — content calendars, creatives, campaigns and community management on the platforms where your customers spend time.

faqs.q: Which platforms do you manage?
faqs.a: Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn — the channels where most B2B and local B2C buying decisions get researched. We recommend the mix per business, not all three by default.

faqs.q: Do you create the content?
faqs.a: Yes — calendar, copy, creatives and scheduling are all included. You approve the monthly plan; we handle execution.

faqs.q: Do you run paid campaigns?
faqs.a: Yes, where the numbers justify it: boosting proven organic posts and running targeted lead or awareness campaigns with clear budgets.

faqs.q: How do you report results?
faqs.a: Monthly: reach, engagement, follower quality, profile visits, website clicks and leads — tied back to the content that produced them.

faqs.q: Can you handle customer messages?
faqs.a: Yes — comment moderation and inbox replies within agreed hours, with escalation rules for sensitive issues.

faqs.q: Do you also do SEO?
faqs.a: Yes — our Digital Marketing service covers technical SEO, content and AI-search visibility, which pairs naturally with social.
